SITE INFORMATION

Privacy & cookies.

A simple website, without sign-in or advertising trackers added by Travelber.

Updated: 18 October 2026.

Browsing

Travelber does not currently set analytics or advertising cookies, load advertising scripts or store favourites in your browser. Guide search happens inside the page; queries are not sent to a search service. Photographs and fonts do not require third-party requests.

Hosting

Cloudflare Pages delivers this site. Hosting and security can involve processing technical request information such as IP addresses and browser information under the provider’s policies. See Cloudflare’s privacy policy.

Email

When you contact admin@travelber.com, you share your address and message so we can respond. Avoid sensitive information. Use that address for privacy questions or requests concerning your correspondence.

External links

Other websites have their own privacy practices. Travelber processes no bookings or payments.

Future features

Before adding analytics, affiliate tracking or newsletters, we will update this notice and introduce any required consent controls. We do not display an acceptance banner for marketing tools that this release does not use.
